chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
God’s curse be upon those who contend/dispute in His religion; they are cursed upon the tongue of His Prophet.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people cursed by God for disputing in His religion according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (a.s.) identifies those who engage in contentious disputations regarding the divine religion as cursed, a verdict confirmed by the Prophet Muhammad’s (s.a.w.w.) own tongue. This highlights the Shia emphasis on *Jadal* (contentious argumentation) as a distinct vice that distorts the clarity of *Deen*, linking the authority of the Imams directly to the prophetic tradition.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-288 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
“God’s Curse be upon those who fight with the believers over God’s religion. They are also cursed by His Prophet (S).”
